text: {"label":"Bidirectional and Incidental Naming","definition":"Research on bidirectional naming, the joining of listener and speaker responses to a word without direct teaching, covering its components, assessment, induction through multiple-exemplar or mixed-operant instruction, and links to derived relations.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on naming as a developmental capability, unlike broader verbal operant and grammar analyses, foreign-language instruction, or spelling and sight-word reading interventions."}
